label: Lobby
description: Lobby instance plugin — auto-redirects players from a lobby server to the right destination match server.

commands.name: go
commands.description: Redirects you to a destination server (or the assigned one if no slug given).

commands.name: lobbyset
commands.description: Assigns a player to a specific destination server.

commands.name: lobbyclear
commands.description: Clears a player's (or everyone's) destination assignment.

commands.name: lobbysend
commands.description: Immediately redirects a player to a destination server.

commands.name: lobbynotify
commands.description: Debug — re-checks pending redirect/notify data for all connected players.
